$comment: THE slice manifest: which optional platform slices this app mounts. `enabled` is the list you edit: remove a line to drop a slice, add an id to turn one on; order does not matter. `catalog` is the fixed list of slices the starter can mount, in mount order, with what each requires: the API (apps/api/src/platform/slices) and the web app (apps/web/src/slices) both read this one file and refuse to start when an enabled slice requires one that is not (the error names both). README, 'Optional slices' has the table.

credentials.label: Encrypted credential store (deployment, user and organization tiers)

storage.label: Object storage: uploads, profile pictures, the storage admin page

email.label: Email: SES and SMTP transports, templates, the email settings page

notifications.label: Notifications: inbox, preferences, email, Web Push, broadcasts

sharing.label: Sharing: groups, invites, grants and link shares

ai.label: AI gateway: providers, keys, models, usage, admin pages

db-backup.label: Database backup and restore (pg_dump to object storage)

exports.label: Data export: signed downloads of a user's or an organization's data

onboarding.label: First-run onboarding: welcome dialog, Get started, Setup guide

android-app.label: Android companion: TWA trust, hosted APK releases, push channel

telemetry.label: Telemetry: OpenTelemetry export gate, GreptimeDB explorer, dashboard, metric groups
